title: The Labour Laws (Exemption from Furnishing Returns and Maintaining Registers by certain Establishments) Act, 1988
full_text: Act is under updation and will be uploaded shortly. Department: Department of LABOUR Enforcement Date: 01-05-1989 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Labour and Employment, ) Location: Chhattisgarh Notification: 1st May, 1989, vide notification No. G.S.R. 436(E), dated 10th April, 1989, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(i).
